title: A Lean proof establishes the word count behind OEIS A108081
summary: GPT-5.6 Sol produced a formal proof counting words generated by a reverse-and-shift concatenation rule. For length n, the count is A108081 at index n−1, a known Fibonacci transform whose connection to the word rule is the result proved.
ai_technology: GPT-5.6 Sol; h1 Lean proof-search harness

source_review.scope: Pinned Atlas Lean theorem and August 28 merge; September Formal Conjectures PR and its independent axiom check; h1 Table 1 and Appendix D

evidence.tested: The proof relates the words of each positive length to the sequence using the matching coordinate enumeration. A maintainer reviewer independently replayed the linked version and reported only standard Lean axioms.
evidence.unknown: This is a theorem about the specified combinatorial word-generation rule. The existing integer sequence predates the proof.
evidence.ai_role: The h1 harness used GPT-5.6 Sol to generate a proof script with feedback from the Lean 4 checker.
